description: This Java class provides utility methods for performing MongoDB persistence operations such as dropping collections and deleting documents by filter, using reactive streams.

classes.name: MongoOpsUtil
classes.description: Utility class for MongoDB persistence operations using reactive streams.

methods.name: drop
methods.description: Drops the specified Mongo collection and returns a reactive stream indicating success or failure.

methods.name: deleteByFilter
methods.description: Deletes documents from the collection matching the given filter, returning a reactive stream of errors if any.

methods.name: doDrop
methods.description: Performs the drop operation on the collection, handling success and errors.

methods.name: doDeleteByFilter
methods.description: Performs delete operations based on filter, with logging and error handling.
